stem: The bar graph shows the number of rainy days recorded at a weather station in Mumbai, India, in each of four months of one year. If one of these rainy days is selected at random, what is the probability that it was in July?

figure.title: Rainy days recorded at the station

solution: The rainy days recorded are \(12 + 20 + 18 + 10 = 60\), and 20 of them were in July.

explanation.A: Correct. July had 20 of the \(12 + 20 + 18 + 10 = 60\) rainy days, so the probability is \(\frac{20}{60} = \frac{1}{3}\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This treats the four months as equally likely, but the day is selected from the rainy days, and the months had different numbers of rainy days.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{20}{122}\), which divides by the total number of days in the four months instead of the number of rainy days.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{40}{60}\), the probability that the rainy day was NOT in July.

verify:
pts = dict(figure['series'][0]['points'])
tot = sum(pts.values())
assert tot == 60
p = Rational(pts['July'], tot)
assert p == Rational(1, 3)
assert value(choices[answer]) == p
assert all(value(choices[k]) != p for k in choices if k != answer)
